name: ChannelHoarder
description: ChannelHoarder is a self-hosted video channel archiver with a modern web UI. Monitor and automatically download videos from YouTube, Rumble, Twitch, Dailymotion, Vimeo, and Odysee. Videos are saved in Plex-compatible TV Show format (Channel / Season Year / S01E01 - Title). Features a built-in PO token server so no YouTube account or cookies are required. Includes real-time download progress, per-channel quality settings, Shorts filtering, Telegram/Pushover notifications, and import support for existing video libraries.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: Video download directory. Point your Plex TV Shows library here.

paths.name: Cookies Watch Dir
paths.description: Optional: drop an updated cookies.txt here and it will be picked up automatically

paths.name: Extra Media Path
paths.description: Optional: additional host path for per-channel custom download directories outside /downloads. To download here you must also list the container path (/media) in the 'Extra Download Dirs' variable below.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Web interface port. Access the UI at http://your-server-ip:8587

variables.name: Extra Download Dirs
variables.description: Comma-separated container paths (besides /downloads) that channels are allowed to download into. Each must match the container-side target of an extra path you mapped above - e.g. /media for the Extra Media Path, or add your own like /media,/playlists.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions. Use 99 for nobody on Unraid.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions. Use 100 for users on Unraid.

variables.name: YouTube API Key
variables.description: Optional: YouTube Data API v3 key for faster and more reliable channel discovery

variables.name: PO Token Server
variables.description: Enable built-in PO token server for YouTube authentication (recommended)
